# Drink and drive Burgas

Premium 24/7 Drink and Drive services in Burgas and the surrounding Burgas Province (oblast Burgas), Bulgaria.

## Contact Info
- Phone for orders: +359 88 661 1719 (Active 24/7)
- Email: office@drinkanddrive-burgas.com
- Viber / WhatsApp / Call links are supported.

## Coverage Areas (Burgas Province)
- Burgas City (Center, Lazur, Sea Garden, Meden Rudnik, Slaveykov, Izgrev, Sarafovo, Kraimorie, Vetren / Banevo)
- Province Towns: Pomorie, Sozopol, Nesebar, Primorsko, Ruen, Sredets, Sungurlare, Tsarevo.

## Pricing & Rates (30% Discounted)
- Base Price (includes first 3 km): 7.00 BGN (~3.58 EUR)
- Price per additional km: 2.10 BGN (~1.07 EUR)
- Accompanying professional second driver is included in the price.
